hypothesis: The partial unique replay-identity index prevents duplicate durable rows but does not by itself serialize replay classification; two writers can both observe no existing replay before one loses the later INSERT race.
counterhypothesis: SQLite WAL plus the unique index may be sufficient because the losing writer could naturally re-observe the row and classify cleanly without an exception.

cheap_discriminator.interpretation: Counterhypothesis falsified at generic SQLite/WAL transaction-semantics scope. Duplicate minting was not observed; the gap is deterministic fail-closed availability/classification under concurrency.

A_ENTITYOS_EXECUTABLE_CONVERGENCE.delta: Refined the replay-stable Forge-to-Distillery executable gate to require atomic concurrent replay classification, not only a unique replay index.

B_HCU_AND_TYPED_ENTRY_FABRIC_CO_DEVELOPM.delta: Defined an atomic causal-admission invariant reusable at Typed Entry/HCU ingress boundaries: replay lookup, measured-evidence conflict classification, packet write and token counters must be serialized as one admission transaction.

C_GLOBAL_JSPACE_GWT_PROTOTYPE_AND_FREE_O.delta: Added dataset-ingress concurrency safety as a prerequisite so semantic replay under parallel ingestion cannot become ambiguous process failure or weaken future J-Space trace dataset accounting.
